links.outcome: Presence of formal AI policies versus resident independent AI use
links.effect: 88% of PDs reported no formal AI policy; 50% of residents used AI independently, mostly ChatGPT (50%), without institutional guidance.
links.quote: Only 8% of PDs reported screening residency applications for AI-generated content, and 88% indicated their programs had no formal policies on AI use.

links.outcome: Availability of AI education and training resources for residents
links.effect: 74% of residents said programs lacked AI educational resources; 21% of programs offered AI ethics training; AI-based educational tools in 13% of programs.
links.quote: Despite this engagement, 74% stated their programs lacked AI-related educational resources.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of plastic surgery program directors and residents examining current AI policies, educational usage, and attitudes; it reports on institutional governance and practice adoption but does not test or compare specific deployment practices.
